info.name: BBL Bookmarks API — manual tests
info.description: Manual test collection for the BBL bookmark manager API. Follow docs/API_MANUAL_TESTING.md. Auth: OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code + PKCE (S256) against the Auth0 tenant; the API accepts the ACCESS token. Never commit an exported copy of this collection after getting a token: Postman stores tokens inside it.

item.name: GET /me (creates your user on first call)

exec: pm.test('trimmed name, owner is me, exact fields', () => { pm.expect(c.name).to.eql('Postman Reading'); pm.expect(c.ownerId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('myUserId')); pm.expect(Object.keys(c).sort()).to.eql(['createdAt','id','name','ownerId','updatedAt']); });
pm.test('matches Postman Reading', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.map(c => c.name)).to.include('Postman Reading'));
pm.test('one item and a cursor', () => { pm.expect(body.data.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(body.nextCursor).to.be.a('string'); });

pm.test('identical 404 body (not yours == missing == malformed)', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.eql({type:'about:blank',title:'Not Found',status:404,detail:'The requested resource was not found',code:'not_found'}));

pm.test('identical 404 body (not yours == missing == malformed)', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.eql({type:'about:blank',title:'Not Found',status:404,detail:'The requested resource was not found',code:'not_found'}));
pm.test('ownerId is not allowed', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().errors).to.deep.include({field:'ownerId',message:'is not allowed'}));

pm.test('trimmed title, blank notes → null, no collection, exact fields', () => { pm.expect(b.title).to.eql('NestJS'); pm.expect(b.notes).to.eql(null); pm.expect(b.collectionId).to.eql(null); pm.expect(Object.keys(b).sort()).to.eql(['collectionId','createdAt','id','notes','ownerId','title','updatedAt','url']); });

pm.test('all in that collection', () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.length).to.be.above(0); d.forEach(b => pm.expect(b.collectionId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('collectionId'))); });
pm.test('back, notes cleared', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.collectionId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('collectionId')); pm.expect(b.notes).to.eql(null); });
pm.test('replaced', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.url).to.eql('https://docs.nestjs.com'); pm.expect(b.notes).to.eql(null); pm.expect(b.collectionId).to.eql(null); });

pm.test('identical 404 body (not yours == missing == malformed)', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.eql({type:'about:blank',title:'Not Found',status:404,detail:'The requested resource was not found',code:'not_found'}));

pm.test('identical 404 body (not yours == missing == malformed)', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.eql({type:'about:blank',title:'Not Found',status:404,detail:'The requested resource was not found',code:'not_found'}));
